title: Notifs Events
description: A set of notification events reporting state transitions. [Notifs Events Documentation](../docs/messages/notifs.md#telemetry)

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the notification event was generated

partial_update.description: Indicates if this is a partial update

notif_id.description: Map of notification event objects keyed by notification identifier for this device.

^[0-9a-f]{8}$.description: Object representation for a single notification event
